Policies.legalNoteBody: Nke a bụ nchịkọta n'asụsụ dị mfe. Zervia ga-eme ka onye ọka iwu nyochaa ederede iwu zuru oke tupu mmalite.
Policies.terms_intro_body: Zervia connects customers with local service providers. By using Zervia you agree to these terms. Zervia is a marketplace: providers are independent — we introduce, you decide.
Policies.terms_accounts_body: You must provide accurate information and keep your password private. One account per person. You must be of legal age in your country to book services.
Policies.terms_providers_body: Listings must describe real services you can deliver. Fake, misleading, or illegal listings are removed and repeat offenders are banned. New providers are approved by our team before going public.
Policies.terms_payments_body: Subscriptions and boosts are billed through Stripe. Prices are shown before you pay; taxes may apply in your country. You can cancel subscriptions anytime from your billing page.
Policies.terms_conduct_body: No spam, scams, harassment, or fake reviews. Reviews may only come from real completed bookings. Breaking these rules can end your account.
Policies.terms_termination_body: You can delete your account anytime from the privacy center. We may suspend accounts that break these terms, with an explanation and a chance to appeal.
Policies.terms_changes_body: We'll post updates here and notify you of important changes before they take effect.
Policies.privacy_intro_body: Zervia collects only what it needs to run the marketplace. This policy explains what we collect, why, and your rights (including under Canada's PIPEDA and the EU/UK GDPR).
Policies.privacy_collect_body: Account details (name, email, country, language), listings and bookings you create, reviews, support messages, and ID photos you choose to upload for verification. We never see your payment card details — Stripe handles those.
Policies.privacy_use_body: To operate your account, show listings, process bookings, prevent fraud, and improve Zervia. We do not sell your personal data. Ever.
Policies.privacy_share_body: Your public profile, listings, and reviews are visible to everyone. ID verification photos are private — only you and the Zervia review team can see them. We share data with service providers we need to run Zervia (hosting, payments, email) under strict contracts.
Policies.privacy_rights_body: Access, correct, export, or delete your data — anytime, from the in-app privacy center. We'll respond to requests promptly as the law requires.
Policies.privacy_security_body: Passwords are handled by our auth provider (we never see them), data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is strictly limited by role.
Policies.privacy_contact_body: Contact us through the support hub in the app — we answer privacy questions first.
Policies.refunds_intro_body: If Zervia charges you for something that didn't work as described, we'll make it right. Here's exactly how.
Policies.refunds_subscriptions_body: Cancel anytime from your billing page — you keep the paid period, and it won't renew. Refunds for the current period are granted if you cancel within 7 days of being charged and haven't used paid features since.
Policies.refunds_boosts_body: Boosts start immediately when activated and can't be refunded once live. If a boost never activated due to our error, you get a full refund or a free re-run — your choice.
Policies.refunds_leadfees_body: Lead fees are only charged on genuine customer bookings. Duplicate or fraudulent leads are credited — report them and we investigate within 3 business days.
Policies.refunds_disputes_body: Payments for services go to providers, not Zervia — we can't refund their work, but our dispute team mediates and documents every case. Open a dispute from your booking page.
Policies.refunds_contact_body: Open a support ticket from the app (category: billing) and we'll respond within 2 business days.
Policies.offlineBody: Zervia chọrọ ịntanetị maka ibe a.

Support.title: Nkwado
Support.subtitle: Azịza nye ajụjụ ndị a na-ajụkarị — na ụzọ kwụ ọtọ nye ndị otu Zervia.
Support.faqA1: Zervia bụ otu ngwa maka ihe niile — ọrụ mpaghara ndị a tụkwasịrị obi, ndoputa, na ụgwọ ọrụ. Anyị na-emepe mpaghara site na mpaghara; sonye na ndepụta nchere ka ị bụrụ onye mbụ na mpaghara gị.
Support.faqQ2: Kedu mgbe Zervia ga-abata na mpaghara m?
Support.faqA2: Anyị na-agbasa nwayọ nwayọ. Sonye na ndepụta nchere, anyị ga-ezitere gị ozi-e mgbe anyị mepere nso gị.
Support.faqQ3: Kedu ka ndoputa ọrụ ga-esi arụ ọrụ?
Support.faqA3: Kọwaa ihe ị chọrọ, họrọ onye na-enye ọrụ na mpaghara gị, depụta na ịpị ole na ole, kwụọ ụgwọ na ngwa ahụ.
Support.faqQ4: Kedu ka akara ụgwọ ọrụ si arụ ọrụ?
Support.faqA4: Nweta akara site na isonye, imecha ndoputa, ide nyocha, na ịkpọ ndị enyi. Ndị na-enye ọrụ nwere ike ịgbanwe akara iji kwalite mgbasa ozi ha.
Support.faqQ5: Kedu ka m ga-esi nye ọrụ m na Zervia?
Support.faqA5: Mepụta akaụntụ wee mechaa ndebanye aha onye na-enye ọrụ iji depụta ihe ị na-eme wee malite ịnata ndoputa.
Support.faqQ6: Kedu ka m ga-esi nweta enyemaka gbasara ndoputa?
Support.faqA6: Zitere anyị ozi site na fọm dị n'okpuru — ndị otu Zervia na-agụ ozi ọ bụla ma ga-aza gị site na ozi-e.

Trust.title: Verification & Trust
Trust.subtitle: Verified providers win more bookings. Complete the checks below to climb the trust tiers.
Trust.trustExplainer: Trust tiers are earned: Verified needs an approved ID, Trusted needs 10+ completed jobs with 4.5+ stars, Top Rated needs 50+ jobs with 4.8+ stars and almost no disputes. Reviews only ever come from completed bookings.
Trust.docType_government_id_hint: Driver's license, passport, or national ID.
Trust.docType_professional_license_hint: Trade or professional license for your service category.
Trust.requestBody: Upload a clear photo or scan. Your document goes to a private vault — only you and the Zervia review team can see it.
Trust.uploadPrivacy: Private: never shown publicly, only reviewed by the Zervia team.
Trust.submitFailed: Could not submit. Please try again.
Trust.requestReceived: Received! We'll review your document and update your trust status.
Trust.queueSubtitle: Review provider identity documents. Approving an ID automatically marks the provider verified.
Trust.rejectReasonHint: e.g. Photo is blurry — please upload a clearer scan.
Trust.actionDone: Done — the provider's trust status has been updated.

Availability.title: My availability
Availability.subtitle: Tell customers when you're free — available providers rank higher on Discover.
Availability.weeklyHint: Check the days you work and set your hours. Unchecked days are closed.
Availability.nextHint: The earliest date you can take a new job. Leave empty if you're flexible.

Tiers.maxTier: You've reached the highest tier. You're a Zervia legend!
Tiers.tierNewDesc: Welcome aboard! Complete jobs to climb the tiers.
Tiers.tierRisingDesc: 10+ completed jobs. You're building momentum — Featured Boost unlocked!
Tiers.tierEstablishedDesc: 50+ completed jobs with 4.5+ stars. Priority ranking unlocked.
Tiers.tierTopRatedDesc: 100+ completed jobs with 4.8+ stars. The best of the best.
Tiers.wizardSubtitle: Answer 5 quick questions and we'll draft your listing for you.
Tiers.wizardQ_service_hint: One line — e.g. "Deep house cleaning" or "Faucet and toilet repairs".
Tiers.wizardQ_included: What's included in a typical job?
Tiers.wizardQ_included_hint: List what the customer gets — be specific, it builds trust.
Tiers.wizardQ_included_placeholder: e.g. All rooms, bathrooms, kitchen, windows, laundry fold
Tiers.wizardQ_price_hint: A number is fine (e.g. 80), add "/hr" for hourly. Leave blank for "contact for quote".
Tiers.wizardQ_skills: Any special skills, experience, or certifications?
Tiers.wizardQ_skills_hint: Years of experience, licenses, insurance — anything that sets you apart.
Tiers.wizardError: Couldn't generate the draft — please try again.
Tiers.wizardDraftHint: Review and edit below, then publish when it looks right.
Tiers.draftClosing: Book with confidence — verified provider on Zervia.

Payments.heldExplainer: held until the job is done right
Payments.disputedExplainer: An admin is reviewing this dispute. The held payment is safe.
Payments.payPrompt: Pay {amount} now to secure this booking
Payments.payExplainer: Your payment is held safely and released to the provider only when the job is done.
Payments.payFailed: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
Payments.noPaymentYet: No payment has been made for this booking yet.
Payments.testModeNote: Payments run in test mode while Zervia prepares its money-transmitter licensing. No real money moves.
Payments.resolveConfirm: Are you sure? This moves real test-mode money and closes the dispute.
Payments.reworkSubtitle: You have 48 hours after completion to request rework from the provider.
Payments.reworkNotesPlaceholder: Describe what the provider should redo…
